changelog: When you say you are stuck, you are shown who you know is here, whether or not your agent thinks to look. 0.9.12 reminded the agent; this is the part that does not depend on it. If the agent has not looked within about a minute, /vibe itself shows you one line.
features: Say you are stuck and, if someone you know is in a session, you see: /vibe · you said you were stuck · someone you know is here now: @them (what they are working on)
Shown once, only in the session where you said it, and only people you know: never a stranger, an agent, or someone you muted
If your agent already looked for someone, nothing extra is shown
One read of who is here, only when you said you were stuck. What you are stuck on is never read or sent. Quiet turns it off
